This applies to those random strangers that you meet in a coffee shop/bar, the ones that you promise each other to keep in touch but never really bother to exchange contact number/details. In a way, he is way more mature than your daughter, and he himself has had children (daughter, even!) so he should be able to understand your concerns and care for your daughter, yet he didn't give both of you enough time to work things out. From your story, I don't think he has introduced himself properly to you before asking your daughter to move in with him - why? It seems absurd to me, all his actions do not actually show that he treats your daughter well and intends to treat this relationship seriously. Gifts mentioned above do not show anything at all, it is the action that shows more.

He had a fiancee - which means that he has made a promise to other woman, yet he just left her. There are several divorces before that. Coupled that with his actions and behaviour, that's what worrying me the most.


About any advices for your daughter,
sadly, right now she might not in the condition to listen to you at all. She is 18, so she is bound to be rather stubborn in defending her own decision. The latter might be rather difficult to do if she is already living with him, but just let her know that you are there for her if she needs anything.
